channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: What happened to the Christmas tree? Cornell professor makes a case for the evergreen
item.description: It's time to bring back the fresh Christmas tree.

item.title: ABA accredits Catholic law school after pushback for alleged religious discrimination
item.description: A Catholic law school announced it is no longer facing a loss of accreditation after 'noncompliance' warnings from the American Bar Association.

item.title: Judge rules against UCLA prof suspended after refusing lenient grading for black students
item.description: A judge ruled against UCLA lecturer Gordon Klein, who was suspended after refusing to grade black students leniently in the wake of George Floyd's death, siding with UCLA on every issue.

item.title: Indiana U. Chinese researcher caught smuggling in E. coli, FBI says
item.description: Youhuang Xiang faces accusations that he smuggled E. coli into the country.

item.title: Michigan State Jewish center vandalized twice over Hanukkah
item.description: Police are seeking the public's help to identify a suspect responsible for vandalizing the Michigan State University Chabad Jewish Center twice during Hanukkah.

item.title: Mizzou student socialists protest law enforcement operation that netted over 30 violent offenders
item.description: The University of Missouri Young Democratic Socialists of America protested against a recent operation that led to 33 arrests, criticizing the collaboration between local authorities and federal agencies. They demanded the shutdown of surveillance systems, fearing increased ICE presence and accusing officials of misrepresenting crime rates to justify federal overreach.

item.title: U.S. under Trump mirrors dystopian ‘It’s a Wonderful Life’ town, professor says
item.description: The current political landscape reflects the dystopian “Pottersville” in the Christmas movie “It’s a Wonderful Life,” a professor wrote in a recent op-ed. She compared the tyrannical setting of the movie to President Donald Trump’s policies on immigration, as well as what she views as growing greed, corruption, and the concentration of political and economic […]

item.title: CU Boulder suspends student journalist for covering protest without permission
item.description: Free speech concerns are being raised about a student journalist at CU-Boulder who is under sanction after covering a protest.

item.title: Eastern Michigan U. radio pulls interview with rabbi on campus antisemitism
item.description: Eastern Michigan University's WEMU radio station removed an interview with Rabbi Yitz Pierce regarding campus antisemitism after a listener complained about its perceived pro-Israel bias.

item.title: OU removes trans instructor who gave Christian student’s Bible-based essay a zero
item.description: 'The graduate teaching assistant will no longer have instructional duties at the university.'
